notes.title: Legacy version
notes.notes: The original version of Contradiction is now on the 'LegacyContradiciton' branch.

notes.title: New overhaul!
notes.notes: This update (for Windows only) has had a complete overhaul, with new interface, better controller handling, better video quality and much improved audio quality.  The game also now autosaves to ensure you'll never lose any progress, even if the game closes without exiting.

notes.title: Replies review option added
notes.notes: The option to review all character's previous replies to items has now been added to the mouse control UI when accessing the inventory outside an interview (this was already available through the keys UI).

notes.title: Cloud storage option
notes.notes:
Small update - the new menu now has the option to choose between cloud or local storage, by default if the Steam client is running the game saves to the Steam cloud, but the option to save locally has now been added to the new menu.

Sorry for any confusion caused - if you've been saving locally this new option should allow you to recover those game saves.

notes.title: New Controls
notes.notes:
I've just published a major update to the controls for the game - you now have the option to play either with mouse only or with keyboard, by clicking the icon in the bottom right.

Due to bugs in the third-party software I'm using I've been unable to fix the USB controller issues, so controller support has now been removed.

notes.title: Pirating
notes.notes: Just a word about pirating this game - if you would like to see a sequel there's going to be no chance of one if everyone pirates it!  Steam is the ONLY official seller of this game, so if you find it anywhere else it's an illegal copy which will not be updated.
